items.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: I had an audition with Duke and got cold feet. They were recording. Someone he was working with said, “Come up to the recording.” I came but I left.

ctx.x: And I’m looking forward to your performance tonight. Do you have any, just quickly, any people you’ve been able to play with over the years and meet, that you’d like to say anything about?

Well the only thing I’d like to say is people I’ve met and could’ve worked for and didn’t take the opportunity, like working with Lionel Hampton’s band. I had an audition with Duke and got cold feet. They were recording. Someone he was working with said, “Come up to the recording.” I came but I left. I got cold feet. That’s somebody I really would love to have worked with. And I think I got overwhelmed by the thought of Duke Ellington you know.
Well I appreciate your time today. Thank you very much for your conversation.
